what: The design sweep (11 designs, three masses, stand, trot and crawl at three speeds, 10 s per run) with 10 random draws per cell: every body mass times a uniform 0.95 to 1.05 and servo latency uniform 18 to 22 ms, the same 10 draws in every cell. Gait timings and servo gains not re-tuned. All dimensions, masses, servo figures, friction and joint limits are placeholders.
